Question: When the roots of the polynomial \[P(x) = (x-1)^1(x-2)^2(x-3)^3 \cdots (x-10)^{10}\] are removed from the real number line, what remains is the union of \(11\) disjoint open intervals. On how many of those intervals is \(P(x)\) positive?
